llmTip: CRITICAL: $search value MUST be wrapped in double quotes. CANNOT combine $search and $filter — use one or the other. ADVANCED FILTERS: InefficientFilter error (400) → $filter on flag/flagStatus or contains() without advanced mode → add $count=true. Example: $filter="flag/flagStatus eq 'flagged'" with $count=true. Flag status values: 'flagged', 'complete', 'notFlagged'. WARNING: folderId='flaggedItems' with $search returns unreliable flag status — use $filter with $count=true instead.

Well-known folder names can be used as folder IDs in other endpoints: inbox, drafts, sentitems, deleteditems, junkemail, archive, clutter, scheduled. Example: list-mail-folder-messages with mailFolder-id='inbox' — no need to list folders first for standard folders.
Well-known folder names can be used as mailFolder-id: inbox, drafts, sentitems, deleteditems, junkemail, archive.
Creates a top-level mail folder. Use create-mail-child-folder to create a subfolder inside an existing folder.
Creates a subfolder inside an existing mail folder. Use list-mail-folders or list-mail-child-folders to find the parent folder ID.
Renames a mail folder by updating its displayName. Use list-mail-folders to find the folder ID.
Deletes a mail folder and all its contents. This action is irreversible. Use list-mail-folders to find the folder ID.

CRITICAL: $search value MUST be wrapped in double quotes. CANNOT combine $search and $filter — use one or the other. Well-known folder names can be used as folderId: inbox, drafts, sentitems, deleteditems, junkemail, archive. ADVANCED FILTERS: InefficientFilter error (400) → $filter on flag/flagStatus or contains() without advanced mode → add $count=true. Example: $filter="flag/flagStatus eq 'flagged'" with $count=true. Flag status values: 'flagged', 'complete', 'notFlagged'. WARNING: folderId='flaggedItems' with $search returns unreliable flag status — use $filter with $count=true instead.

Retrieves a single email message. Use $select to limit returned fields, e.g. $select=id,subject,body,from,toRecipients,ccRecipients,receivedDateTime,hasAttachments,flag,importance. Use $expand=attachments to include attachment metadata inline. For just the body text, use $select=body.

CRITICAL: Do not try to guess the email address of the recipients. Use the list-users tool to find the email address of the recipients. Body format: {"message": {"subject": "...", "body": {"contentType": "html", "content": "

...

"}, "toRecipients": [{"emailAddress": {"address": "user@example.com", "name": "Display Name"}}]}, "saveToSentItems": true}. Use contentType 'html' for rich formatting or 'text' for plain text. Can include ccRecipients, bccRecipients in same format as toRecipients.

CRITICAL: $search value MUST be wrapped in double quotes. CANNOT combine $search and $filter — use one or the other. ADVANCED FILTERS: InefficientFilter error (400) → $filter on flag/flagStatus or contains() without advanced mode → add $count=true. Flag status values: 'flagged', 'complete', 'notFlagged'.

CRITICAL: $search value MUST be wrapped in double quotes. CANNOT combine $search and $filter — use one or the other. Well-known folder names can be used as folderId: inbox, drafts, sentitems, deleteditems, junkemail, archive. ADVANCED FILTERS: InefficientFilter error (400) → $filter on flag/flagStatus or contains() without advanced mode → add $count=true. Flag status values: 'flagged', 'complete', 'notFlagged'.

Returns a single message from a shared mailbox. Use $select to limit fields, e.g. $select=id,subject,body,from,toRecipients,receivedDateTime,hasAttachments. Use $expand=attachments to include attachment metadata.

CRITICAL: Do not try to guess the email address of the recipients. Use the list-users tool to find the email address of the recipients. Body format: {"message": {"subject": "...", "body": {"contentType": "html", "content": "

...

"}, "toRecipients": [{"emailAddress": {"address": "user@example.com", "name": "Display Name"}}]}, "saveToSentItems": true}. Use contentType 'html' for rich formatting or 'text' for plain text.

CRITICAL: This request requires the ConsistencyLevel header set to eventual. When searching users, the $search parameter value MUST be wrapped in double quotes. Format: $search="your search query here". Use KQL (Keyword Query Language) syntax to search specific properties: 'displayName:'. Examples: $search="displayName:john" | $search="displayName:john" OR "displayName:jane". Remember: ALWAYS wrap the entire search expression in double quotes and set the ConsistencyLevel header to eventual!

Creates a draft email (does not send). Body format: {"subject": "...", "body": {"contentType": "html", "content": "

...

"}, "toRecipients": [{"emailAddress": {"address": "user@example.com", "name": "Display Name"}}]}. Can include ccRecipients, bccRecipients in same format. Use contentType 'html' for rich formatting or 'text' for plain text. CRITICAL: Do not guess email addresses — use list-users to find them. After creating the draft, use send-draft-message with the returned message id to send it.
Moves the message to Deleted Items folder (soft delete). To permanently delete, delete again from the deleteditems folder. This action cannot be undone once permanently deleted.

CRITICAL: The destinationId requires a folder ID, not a display name. Use well-known folder names directly as IDs: inbox, drafts, sentitems, deleteditems, junkemail, archive. For custom folders, use list-mail-folders first to get the folder ID. Body format: {"destinationId": "inbox"} or {"destinationId": "AAMkAD..."}.

Updates mail message properties. PATH PARAMETER: use 'messageId' (camelCase) — both 'message-id' and 'messageId' are accepted. BODY: pass a 'body' parameter with the properties as a JSON object. Examples: body={"isRead": true} to mark as read, body={"flag": {"flagStatus": "flagged"}} to flag, body={"flag": {"flagStatus": "complete"}} to mark complete, body={"categories": ["Blue category"]} to categorize, body={"importance": "high"} to set importance. Flag status values: 'flagged', 'complete', 'notFlagged'. Can update: isRead, categories, importance, flag, subject, inferenceClassification. Do NOT wrap in a 'message' envelope.

Adds an attachment to a message (usually a draft). IMPORTANT: Maximum 3MB per attachment via this endpoint — larger files need a createUploadSession (not available here). Body format: {"@odata.type": "#microsoft.graph.fileAttachment", "name": "filename.pdf", "contentType": "application/pdf", "contentBytes": "base64-encoded-content"}. contentBytes must be base64-encoded.

Lists attachments on a message. Use $select=id,name,contentType,size to reduce response size. To get the actual file content, use get-mail-attachment with the specific attachment-id. Attachment types: #microsoft.graph.fileAttachment (files), #microsoft.graph.itemAttachment (Outlook items), #microsoft.graph.referenceAttachment (links).
Returns a single attachment by ID. For file attachments (#microsoft.graph.fileAttachment), contentBytes contains base64-encoded file content. Use $select=id,name,contentType,size,contentBytes.
Permanently removes an attachment from a message. This cannot be undone. Use list-mail-attachments first to get the attachment-id.

Forward an email preserving full HTML formatting and attachments. The 'comment' field adds text above the forwarded content. Body format: {"comment": "See below", "toRecipients": [{"emailAddress": {"address": "user@example.com", "name": "Display Name"}}]}. Do NOT reconstruct the email manually — this endpoint handles everything server-side including original body and attachments.

Reply to sender only, preserving full HTML formatting. Body format: {"comment": "Your reply text here"}. The comment can contain HTML. Do NOT reconstruct the email manually — this endpoint handles the original message thread server-side.

Reply to all recipients (sender + all To/CC), preserving full HTML formatting. Body format: {"comment": "Your reply text here"}. The comment can contain HTML. Do NOT reconstruct the email manually — this endpoint handles the original message thread server-side.
Create a forward draft (does not send). Useful when user wants to review before sending.
Creates a reply draft to sender only (does not send). Returns a new draft message that can be modified before sending with send-draft-message. Useful when user wants to review or edit before sending.
Creates a reply-all draft (sender + all To/CC recipients, does not send). Returns a new draft message that can be modified before sending with send-draft-message.
Sends a previously created draft message. No request body needed — just call with the draft message-id. The draft must exist in the Drafts folder. After sending, the message moves to Sent Items.

WARNING: This endpoint only returns non-recurring events and seriesMaster entries — it does NOT expand recurring event instances. For 'what's on my calendar this week', use get-calendar-view instead which expands recurring instances within a date range. Use $filter for date ranges: $filter=start/dateTime ge '2026-03-04T00:00:00' and end/dateTime le '2026-03-05T23:59:59'. Use $select=id,subject,start,end,location,attendees,organizer,isAllDay,recurrence to reduce response size. Use $orderby=start/dateTime to sort chronologically.

Returns a single calendar event. Use $select=id,subject,body,start,end,location,attendees,organizer,isAllDay,recurrence,onlineMeeting to limit fields. For recurring events, this returns the seriesMaster — use list-calendar-event-instances to expand into individual occurrences.

CRITICAL: Do not guess email addresses — use list-users to find them. DateTime format: ISO 8601 with timezone, e.g. {"dateTime": "2026-03-04T09:00:00", "timeZone": "Europe/Brussels"}. Body format: {"subject": "...", "body": {"contentType": "html", "content": "

...

"}, "start": {"dateTime": "...", "timeZone": "..."}, "end": {"dateTime": "...", "timeZone": "..."}, "attendees": [{"emailAddress": {"address": "user@example.com", "name": "Display Name"}, "type": "required"}]}. Attendee type: 'required', 'optional', or 'resource'. Use contentType 'html' for rich formatting or 'text' for plain text.

CRITICAL: Do not guess email addresses — use list-users to find them. Pass only the properties you want to update. DateTime format: {"dateTime": "2026-03-04T09:00:00", "timeZone": "Europe/Brussels"}. Attendees format: [{"emailAddress": {"address": "user@example.com", "name": "Display Name"}, "type": "required"}]. Attendee type: 'required', 'optional', or 'resource'. Body format: {"contentType": "html", "content": "

...

"}. WARNING: Updating attendees replaces the entire list — include ALL attendees, not just new ones. For recurring events: updating a seriesMaster changes all occurrences; to update a single occurrence, use its specific instance ID from get-calendar-view.
Deletes a calendar event. For recurring events: deleting a seriesMaster deletes ALL occurrences. To cancel a single occurrence, delete the specific instance ID obtained from get-calendar-view.

Lists events from a specific (non-default) calendar. WARNING: Only returns non-recurring events and seriesMasters — does NOT expand recurring instances. Use get-specific-calendar-view for expanded recurring instances. Requires calendar-id from list-calendars. Use $select=id,subject,start,end,location,attendees,organizer,isAllDay,recurrence to reduce response size.
Returns a single event from a specific calendar. Use $select to limit fields. Requires calendar-id from list-calendars.

CRITICAL: Do not guess email addresses — use list-users to find them. Creates an event on a specific (non-default) calendar. DateTime format: {"dateTime": "2026-03-04T09:00:00", "timeZone": "Europe/Brussels"}. Body format: {"subject": "...", "body": {"contentType": "html", "content": "

...

"}, "start": {"dateTime": "...", "timeZone": "..."}, "end": {"dateTime": "...", "timeZone": "..."}, "attendees": [{"emailAddress": {"address": "user@example.com", "name": "Display Name"}, "type": "required"}]}. Attendee type: 'required', 'optional', or 'resource'. Use list-calendars first to get the calendar-id.

CRITICAL: Do not guess email addresses — use list-users to find them. Pass only the properties you want to update. DateTime format: {"dateTime": "2026-03-04T09:00:00", "timeZone": "Europe/Brussels"}. Attendees format: [{"emailAddress": {"address": "user@example.com", "name": "Display Name"}, "type": "required"}]. Attendee type: 'required', 'optional', or 'resource'. Body format: {"contentType": "html", "content": "

...

"}. WARNING: Updating attendees replaces the entire list — include ALL attendees. For recurring events: updating a seriesMaster changes all occurrences.
Deletes an event from a specific calendar. Same behavior as delete-calendar-event — deleting a seriesMaster deletes ALL occurrences.

Returns expanded recurring event instances (not just seriesMaster) within a date range for the default calendar. Requires startDateTime and endDateTime query parameters in ISO 8601 format (e.g., 2024-01-01T00:00:00Z). Use get-specific-calendar-view if you need a non-default calendar. To find Teams meetings, use $filter=isOnlineMeeting eq true. To search by subject, use $filter=contains(subject,'keyword'). Teams meetings include a joinWebUrl property needed for transcript access via list-online-meetings.

Returns expanded recurring event instances (not just seriesMaster) within a date range for a specific calendar. Requires startDateTime and endDateTime query parameters in ISO 8601 format (e.g., 2024-01-01T00:00:00Z). Each instance includes seriesMasterId and type (occurrence/exception) fields for recurring event linkage. Use fetchAllPages=true to retrieve all results when there are many events. To find Teams meetings, use $filter=isOnlineMeeting eq true. Teams meetings include a joinWebUrl property needed for transcript access via list-online-meetings.

Expand a recurring event into individual instances within a date range. Requires startDateTime and endDateTime query parameters in ISO 8601 format (e.g., 2024-01-01T00:00:00Z). Use this to see all occurrences of a recurring event.

Lists all calendars for the current user. Use $select=id,name,color,isDefaultCalendar to reduce response size. Returns calendar-id needed for specific calendar operations (list-specific-calendar-events, get-specific-calendar-view, etc.).

Suggests meeting times based on attendee availability. CRITICAL: Do not guess email addresses — use list-users first. Body format: {"attendees": [{"emailAddress": {"address": "user@example.com", "name": "Display Name"}, "type": "required"}], "timeConstraint": {"timeslots": [{"start": {"dateTime": "2026-03-04T09:00:00", "timeZone": "Europe/Brussels"}, "end": {"dateTime": "2026-03-04T17:00:00", "timeZone": "Europe/Brussels"}}]}, "meetingDuration": "PT1H"}. meetingDuration uses ISO 8601 duration (PT30M=30min, PT1H=1hour). Returns suggested time slots with confidence ratings.

Lists all drives (OneDrive, SharePoint document libraries) accessible to the user. Returns drive-id needed for all other file operations. The user's personal OneDrive is typically the first result. Use $select=id,name,driveType,webUrl to reduce response size.
Returns the root folder metadata of a drive. Use this to get the root driveItem-id for listing children with list-folder-files. Prefer item IDs over paths for reliability in subsequent operations.

Lists children (files and subfolders) of a folder. Requires drive-id and driveItem-id (the folder's ID). Use $select=id,name,size,lastModifiedDateTime,file,folder,webUrl to reduce response size. Use $orderby=name or $orderby=lastModifiedDateTime desc for sorting. To navigate a path: start with get-drive-root-item for the root ID, then drill down. Prefer item IDs over paths for reliability. Use $top for pagination.

IMPORTANT: This tool returns a temporary download URL (@microsoft.graph.downloadUrl), NOT the file content directly. The URL is pre-authenticated and short-lived. Use it to provide the user a download link. Requires drive-id and driveItem-id.

Moves the item to the recycle bin (soft delete). Can be restored by the user from OneDrive recycle bin. Requires drive-id and driveItem-id. Works for both files and folders — deleting a folder deletes all its contents.

IMPORTANT: This PUT endpoint only supports files up to 4MB. For larger files, a createUploadSession is needed (not exposed in this tool). Pass the file content directly as the request body. The driveItem-id in the path is the target file — to create a new file, use the parent folder's path format: /drives/{drive-id}/items/root:/path/to/filename.ext:/content. Overwrites existing file if same path/ID is used.

Creates a chart in a worksheet. Body format: {"type": "ColumnClustered", "sourceData": "A1:B10", "seriesBy": "Auto"}. Chart types: ColumnClustered, ColumnStacked, Line, Pie, Bar, Area, Doughnut, and more. sourceData is the range address containing the chart data. seriesBy: 'Auto', 'Columns', or 'Rows'. Requires drive-id, driveItem-id (Excel file), and workbookWorksheet-id.

Formats cells in a range. Body format: {"fill": {"color": "#FF0000"}, "font": {"bold": true, "color": "#FFFFFF", "size": 14}}. Supports fill (color), font (bold, italic, size, color, name), borders, alignment (horizontal, vertical, wrapText), and numberFormat. Requires drive-id, driveItem-id (Excel file), and workbookWorksheet-id.

Sorts a range of cells. Body format: {"fields": [{"key": 0, "ascending": true}]}. The key is the 0-based column index within the range to sort by. Can sort by multiple columns by adding more fields entries. Requires drive-id, driveItem-id (Excel file), and workbookWorksheet-id.

Returns values and formatting for a cell range. The address parameter uses Excel A1 notation: 'A1:C10', 'A1', or named ranges. Returns values (2D array), formulas, numberFormat, and text properties. Use $select=values to get just cell values. Requires drive-id, driveItem-id (Excel file), and workbookWorksheet-id. Use list-excel-worksheets to find worksheet IDs.

Lists all worksheets in an Excel workbook. Requires drive-id and driveItem-id of the Excel file — use list-drives and list-folder-files to find these. Returns workbookWorksheet-id (name or ID) needed for all other Excel operations (get-excel-range, format-excel-range, etc.).
Returns notebook-id needed for list-onenote-notebook-sections.
Returns onenoteSection-id needed for list-onenote-section-pages and create-onenote-section-page.
Returns onenotePage-id needed for get-onenote-page-content.
Returns the HTML content of a OneNote page. The response is raw HTML, not JSON. Contains OneNote-specific HTML tags and data attributes. Images are embedded as data URIs or referenced by URL.

CRITICAL: Request body must be valid HTML with proper structure: Page Title

Content here

. Partial HTML or plain text will fail silently or create malformed pages. Content-Type is text/html (handled automatically). Creates page in the default section. Use create-onenote-section-page to target a specific section.

CRITICAL: Request body must be valid HTML with proper structure: Page Title

Content here

. Partial HTML or plain text will fail silently or create malformed pages. Content-Type is text/html (handled automatically). Requires onenoteSection-id — use list-onenote-notebook-sections to find it.
Returns page metadata (title, createdDateTime, lastModifiedDateTime, contentUrl). For the actual HTML content, use get-onenote-page-content instead.
Deletes a OneNote page permanently. Use list-onenote-section-pages to find the page ID.

CRITICAL: Body is a JSON array of patch commands, NOT raw HTML. Each command: {target, action, content}. target='body' appends to page body. Use action='replace' with target='title' to rename page. Valid actions: append, insert, prepend, replace. Valid targets: body, title, or CSS selector. Example: [{"target": "body", "action": "append", "content": "

New text

"}].
Lists shared notebooks in a Microsoft 365 Group (Teams). group-id is the same as team-id from list-joined-teams.
Lists sections in a group notebook. Returns onenoteSection-id needed for list-group-onenote-section-pages.
Lists pages in a group notebook section. Returns onenotePage-id needed for get-group-onenote-page-content.
Returns the HTML content of a OneNote page in a group/Teams notebook. The response is raw HTML, not JSON.

CRITICAL: Request body must be valid HTML with proper structure: Page Title

Content here

. Partial HTML or plain text will fail silently or create malformed pages. Creates page in a group/Teams notebook section.

Lists all To Do task lists. Returns todoTaskList-id needed for all task operations. The default list is typically called 'Tasks'. NOTE: $select is NOT supported by this endpoint — do not pass select parameter, Graph returns 400.

Lists tasks in a To Do list. Requires todoTaskList-id — use list-todo-task-lists to find it. NOTE: $select is NOT supported — do not pass select, Graph returns 400. Use $filter=status eq 'notStarted' or $filter=status eq 'completed' to filter by status. Use $top to limit results. Status values: 'notStarted', 'inProgress', 'completed', 'waitingOnOthers', 'deferred'.

Returns a single To Do task. Requires todoTaskList-id and todoTask-id. NOTE: $select is NOT supported — do not pass select parameter, Graph returns RequestBroker--ParseUri (400). Use $expand=linkedResources to include linked email/resource inline, or use list-todo-linked-resources separately. Returns body content (HTML format). Checklist items are NOT included — use list-todo-checklist-items separately.
Deletes a To Do task list and all its tasks. Requires todoTaskList-id — use list-todo-task-lists to find it. Cannot delete wellknownListName lists (defaultList, flaggedEmails).
Creates a new To Do task list. Body: {"displayName": "My Projects"}. Returns the new list including its id — use this id for create-todo-task and other task operations.
Updates a To Do task list. Requires todoTaskList-id. Pass only properties to update. Example: {"displayName": "New name"}. Cannot update wellknownListName lists (defaultList, flaggedEmails).

Body format: {"title": "...", "importance": "normal", "dueDateTime": {"dateTime": "2026-03-04T00:00:00", "timeZone": "Europe/Brussels"}, "body": {"contentType": "html", "content": "

Details

"}}. IMPORTANT: body field uses HTML contentType, not plain text. Importance values: 'low', 'normal', 'high'. Status defaults to 'notStarted'. Requires todoTaskList-id — use list-todo-task-lists first. NOTE: checklistItems cannot be set via create — use create-todo-checklist-item separately after task creation.

Updates a To Do task. Requires todoTaskList-id and todoTask-id. Pass only properties to update. Example: {"status": "completed"} to complete a task. IMPORTANT: body field uses HTML contentType: {"body": {"contentType": "html", "content": "

Updated

"}}. Status values: 'notStarted', 'inProgress', 'completed', 'waitingOnOthers', 'deferred'. Importance values: 'low', 'normal', 'high'. NOTE: checklistItems cannot be updated via PATCH on task — use create/update/delete-todo-checklist-item separately.

Creates a checklist item on a task. Body: {"displayName": "Item text"}. Requires todoTaskList-id and todoTask-id. Returns the new item including its id. Call multiple times to add multiple items. To check off an item, use update-todo-checklist-item.
Lists all checklist items on a task. Requires todoTaskList-id and todoTask-id. Returns id, displayName, isChecked, checkedDateTime. Use the id for update or delete operations.
Deletes a checklist item from a task. Requires todoTaskList-id, todoTask-id, and checklistItem-id — use list-todo-checklist-items to find the checklistItem-id.

Updates a checklist item. Requires todoTaskList-id, todoTask-id, and checklistItem-id. Pass only properties to update. Example: {"isChecked": true} to check off, {"displayName": "New text"} to rename.
Permanently deletes a To Do task. Requires todoTaskList-id and todoTask-id. This cannot be undone.
Returns a single To Do task list. Requires todoTaskList-id. Returns displayName, wellknownListName, isOwner, isShared.
Returns a single checklist item. Requires todoTaskList-id, todoTask-id, and checklistItem-id.

Lists linked resources on a task (e.g. linked Outlook email). Requires todoTaskList-id and todoTask-id. Returns id, applicationName, displayName, externalId, webUrl. Alternative: use $expand=linkedResources on get-todo-task.
Returns a single linked resource. Requires todoTaskList-id, todoTask-id, and linkedResource-id. Use list-todo-linked-resources to find the id.

Links an external resource to a task. Body: {"applicationName": "Outlook", "displayName": "Email subject", "webUrl": "https://...", "externalId": "optional-external-id"}. Requires todoTaskList-id and todoTask-id. Use to link emails, URLs, or other resources to a task.
Updates a linked resource. Requires todoTaskList-id, todoTask-id, and linkedResource-id. Pass only properties to update. Example: {"displayName": "New title"}.
Removes a linked resource from a task. Requires todoTaskList-id, todoTask-id, and linkedResource-id — use list-todo-linked-resources to find the id.
Lists file attachments on a task. Requires todoTaskList-id and todoTask-id. Returns id, name, contentType, size. Small attachments (<3MB) can be created inline; larger ones require an upload session.
Returns a single attachment including its content (base64). Requires todoTaskList-id, todoTask-id, and attachmentBase-id — use list-todo-attachments to find the id.

Creates a file attachment on a task (max 3MB inline). Body: {"@odata.type": "#microsoft.graph.taskFileAttachment", "name": "file.txt", "contentType": "text/plain", "contentBytes": "base64-encoded-content"}. Requires todoTaskList-id and todoTask-id. For files >3MB use an upload session (not supported via this endpoint).
Deletes a file attachment from a task. Requires todoTaskList-id, todoTask-id, and attachmentBase-id — use list-todo-attachments to find the id.
Lists all inbox rules. Returns id, displayName, isEnabled, conditions (fromAddresses, subjectContains, etc.), actions (moveToFolder, markAsRead, etc.). Read-only.
Lists all Outlook categories. Returns displayName and color (preset0-preset24). Categories can be assigned to emails, calendar events, and tasks.

Lists all Planner tasks assigned to the current user across all plans. Use $select=id,title,planId,bucketId,assignments,percentComplete,dueDateTime,priority,startDateTime,createdDateTime to reduce response size. Priority values: 0=Urgent, 1=Important, 3=Medium, 5=Low, 9=unset.
Returns a Planner plan by ID. Includes plan title, owner (group ID), and container info. To discover plan IDs, use list-joined-teams and then the team's associated plans.

Lists all tasks in a specific plan. Use $select=id,title,bucketId,assignments,percentComplete,dueDateTime,priority,startDateTime to reduce response size. Priority values: 0=Urgent, 1=Important, 3=Medium, 5=Low, 9=unset.

Returns a single Planner task. Includes @odata.etag needed for update operations (set includeHeaders=true). For task description and checklist, use update-planner-task-details endpoint. Use $select to limit fields.

Body format: {"planId": "...", "title": "...", "bucketId": "...", "assignments": {"user-id": {"@odata.type": "#microsoft.graph.plannerAssignment", "orderHint": " !"}}, "dueDateTime": "2026-03-04T00:00:00Z", "priority": 5}. planId is required. Assignments object keyed by user ID — use list-users or list-team-members to find user IDs. Priority: 0=Urgent, 1=Important, 3=Medium, 5=Low. dueDateTime is ISO 8601 UTC.

CRITICAL: Requires If-Match header with the task's ETag. First GET the task (with includeHeaders=true) to obtain @odata.etag, then pass it as If-Match header. Without If-Match, returns 412 Precondition Failed. Pass only changed properties. Assignments: set to plannerAssignment object to assign, set to null to unassign. Priority: 0=Urgent, 1=Important, 3=Medium, 5=Low.
NOTE: Call this with includeHeaders=true before using update-planner-task-details — the ETag from the response header is required for the update (412 Precondition Failed without it).

CRITICAL: Requires If-Match header with the task details' ETag. First GET the task details to obtain @odata.etag (with includeHeaders=true), then pass it as If-Match. Updates description and checklist. Body example: {"description": "...", "checklist": {"unique-guid": {"@odata.type": "#microsoft.graph.plannerChecklistItem", "title": "...", "isChecked": false}}}. Use a unique GUID string for each new checklist item key.

FILTER LIMITATIONS: $filter only supports startswith() on givenName, surname, displayName. No contains(), no eq on emailAddresses. Example: $filter=startswith(displayName,'John'). For broader search, use $search="displayName:john" with ConsistencyLevel header set to eventual. Use $select=id,displayName,givenName,surname,emailAddresses,businessPhones,mobilePhone,companyName,jobTitle to reduce response size. Use $orderby=displayName for alphabetical sorting.
Returns a single contact by ID.

Body format: {"givenName": "...", "surname": "...", "emailAddresses": [{"address": "user@example.com", "name": "Display Name"}], "businessPhones": ["+1234567890"], "mobilePhone": "+1234567890", "companyName": "...", "jobTitle": "..."}. emailAddresses is an array — a contact can have multiple. Key writable properties: givenName, surname, displayName, emailAddresses, businessPhones, homePhones, mobilePhone, companyName, jobTitle, department, officeLocation, homeAddress, businessAddress.

Pass only properties to update as JSON. Example: {"jobTitle": "Manager", "companyName": "Contoso"}. See create-outlook-contact for available properties. WARNING: emailAddresses replaces the full array — include ALL email addresses, not just new ones.
Permanently deletes the contact. This cannot be undone. Use get-outlook-contact first to verify you have the right contact.
Returns the signed-in user's profile. Returns the user-id needed for shared mailbox and delegation operations.

Lists all chats (1:1, group, meeting) for the current user. Use $select=id,topic,chatType,createdDateTime,lastUpdatedDateTime to reduce response size. chatType values: 'oneOnOne', 'group', 'meeting'. Use $expand=members to include participants. Use $orderby=lastUpdatedDateTime desc for most recent first.
Returns a single chat by ID. Use $expand=members to include participant details. chatType: 'oneOnOne', 'group', or 'meeting'.

Lists messages in a chat. Use $top to limit results (default 20, max 50). Messages ordered newest first. Use $select=id,body,from,createdDateTime,messageType to reduce response size. messageType 'message' = normal messages, 'systemEventMessage' = system events.
Returns a single chat message by ID. Includes full body content, attachments, and reactions.

IMPORTANT: Message body must use HTML contentType. Body format: {"body": {"contentType": "html", "content": "

Your message here

"}}. Plain text contentType gets mangled — always use HTML. Supports @mentions with User Name in content and corresponding mentions array.
Lists all Teams the current user is a member of. Use $select=id,displayName,description to reduce response size. Returns team-id needed for channel and member operations.
Returns a single Team by ID. Includes team settings, visibility, and membership info.

Lists channels in a Team. Use $select=id,displayName,description,membershipType to reduce response size. membershipType: 'standard' (visible to all), 'private' (invited members only), 'shared' (cross-org). Returns channel-id needed for message operations.
Returns a single channel by ID. Includes channel description, membership type, and webUrl.
Lists messages in a Teams channel. Use $top to limit results (max 50). Messages ordered newest first. Use $select=id,body,from,createdDateTime,messageType to reduce response size.
Returns a single channel message by ID. Includes full body, attachments, reactions, and mentions.

IMPORTANT: Message body must use HTML contentType. Body format: {"body": {"contentType": "html", "content": "

Your message here

"}}. Plain text contentType gets mangled — always use HTML. Supports @mentions with User Name in content and corresponding mentions array.

IMPORTANT: Message body must use HTML contentType. Body format: {"body": {"contentType": "html", "content": "

Your reply

"}}. Creates a reply in a message thread. Requires team-id, channel-id, and chatMessage-id of the parent message.
Lists replies to a channel message. Returns threaded replies ordered by createdDateTime. Use $top to limit results.
Lists members of a Team. Returns user IDs, display names, and roles. Roles: 'owner', 'member', 'guest'. Useful for finding user IDs for Planner task assignments or @mentions in messages.
Lists replies to a chat message. Returns threaded replies ordered by createdDateTime. Use $top to limit results.

IMPORTANT: Message body must use HTML contentType. Body format: {"body": {"contentType": "html", "content": "

Your reply

"}}. Creates a reply to a specific chat message.

Searches SharePoint sites. Use $search query parameter: $search="keyword". Returns site-id needed for all other SharePoint operations. Use $select=id,displayName,webUrl,description to reduce response size.
Returns a SharePoint site by ID. The site-id format is 'hostname,site-collection-id,site-id' or just the GUID. Use $select=id,displayName,webUrl,description to limit fields.

Lists document libraries (drives) on a SharePoint site. Returns drive-id needed for file operations. The default document library is usually 'Documents'. Use $select=id,name,webUrl to reduce response size.
Returns a specific document library (drive) from a SharePoint site by its drive-id.
Returns site-level items (document libraries, lists). To get items inside a list, use list-sharepoint-site-list-items with the list-id. Use $expand=fields to include column values.
Returns a single site item by ID. For list item column values, add $expand=fields. Get the item ID from list-sharepoint-site-list-items.
Lists all SharePoint lists on a site. Use $select=id,displayName,description to reduce response size. Returns list-id needed for list item operations.
Returns a specific SharePoint list by ID. Includes column definitions and list settings.

IMPORTANT: Add $expand=fields to include actual column values. Without $expand=fields, returns only metadata (IDs and system properties), no user data. Use $filter on fields/ColumnName for filtering list items.
IMPORTANT: Add $expand=fields to include actual column values. Without $expand=fields, returns only metadata, no user data.
Gets a SharePoint site by its server-relative path. The path parameter is the site path, e.g. '/sites/contoso'. Useful when you know the site URL but not the site ID.
Returns recently changed SharePoint sites. Used for sync scenarios — returns a deltaLink for subsequent calls to get only changes since last check.

Microsoft Search across M365 content. Body format: {"requests": [{"entityTypes": ["message"], "query": {"queryString": "budget report"}, "from": 0, "size": 25}]}. Supported entityTypes: 'message' (email), 'event' (calendar), 'driveItem' (files), 'site' (SharePoint), 'listItem' (SharePoint lists), 'chatMessage' (Teams). queryString uses KQL syntax: 'from:user@example.com', 'subject:meeting', 'filetype:pdf', 'path:"sitename"'. Can search multiple entity types in one request by adding more objects to the requests array. Results include hitsContainers with hits and hitHighlights. Maximum size: 25 for messages/events, 500 for driveItems.

CRITICAL: Only returns meetings created via Graph API, not meetings created in Teams client UI. Use $filter=joinWebUrl eq '{url}' to find a specific meeting by its Teams join link. Returns meeting IDs needed for transcript access. To find Teams-client meetings, use get-calendar-view with $filter=isOnlineMeeting eq true — each event includes joinWebUrl for transcript access.
Lists available transcripts for a meeting. Get the meeting ID first via list-online-meetings.
Returns the transcript content in WebVTT format with speaker identification and timestamps.
Returns a temporary download URL for the meeting recording in MP4 format. Use the download URL to access the video file. The recording may be large — do not attempt to stream it inline.

Body: {subject, startDateTime (ISO 8601 with timeZone object), endDateTime (ISO 8601 with timeZone object), participants: {attendees: [{upn: 'user@example.com', role: 'attendee'}]}}. Returns joinWebUrl for the Teams meeting link.
CRITICAL: Only works for meetings created via Graph API. For Teams-client meetings, use get-calendar-view with $filter=isOnlineMeeting eq true.
Returns attendance reports with totalParticipantCount and meetingStartDateTime. Use the attendance report ID to get individual attendee records.
Body: {displayName (required), description (optional), membershipType: 'standard'/'private' (default: standard)}. Private channels require adding members via a separate call.
NOTE: Group conversations are legacy — Microsoft recommends Teams channels instead. Lists conversations in an M365 group. May not work for all group types.
NOTE: Group threads are legacy — Microsoft recommends Teams channels instead. Lists conversation threads in an M365 group.

NOTE: Group threads are legacy — Microsoft recommends Teams. Body format: {"post": {"body": {"contentType": "html", "content": "

Reply text

"}}}.
Returns all Planner plans the user is a member of. Use plan-id to list tasks via list-plan-tasks.
Body: {title (required), container: {url: 'https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/groups/{group-id}', type: 'group'}}. Container is required — plans must belong to a group.
CRITICAL: Requires If-Match header with ETag from list-planner-plans. Returns 412 without it. Only title can be updated.
CRITICAL: Requires If-Match header with ETag from get-planner-plan. Returns 412 without it.
Returns buckets (columns) in a plan. Use bucket-id with list-plan-tasks to filter tasks by bucket.
Body: {name (required), planId (required), orderHint}. orderHint controls position — use ' !' for first, existing orderHint + ' !' to insert after.
CRITICAL: Requires If-Match header with ETag from get-planner-task. Returns 412 without it.
Body: {comment (optional), sendResponse: true/false}. sendResponse=true sends acceptance email to organizer.
Body: {comment (optional), sendResponse: true/false, proposedNewTime: {start, end} (optional)}. Can propose alternative time.
Body: {comment (optional), sendResponse: true/false, proposedNewTime: {start, end} (optional)}.
Body: {comment (optional)}. Only organizer can cancel. Sends cancellation email to all attendees.
Returns item metadata (name, size, file/folder type, downloadUrl). Use list-folder-files to find item IDs.
Body: {name (required), folder: {}, '@microsoft.graph.conflictBehavior': 'rename'/'replace'/'fail'}. Set folder:{} to create a folder. conflictBehavior='rename' auto-renames on conflict.
Body: {parentReference: {id: 'target-folder-item-id'}, name: 'optional-new-name'}. Use get-drive-item to find parentReference.driveId if moving across drives.
Body: {parentReference: {driveId, id}, name (optional)}. Returns 202 Accepted — async operation. Response Location header has monitor URL.
Returns items matching search query across entire drive. Searches name and content. Use $select to limit fields.
Returns a single calendar by ID. Use list-calendars to find calendar IDs.
Body: {name (required), color (optional): 'lightBlue','lightGreen','lightOrange','lightGray','lightYellow','lightTeal','lightPink','lightBrown','lightRed','maxColor','auto'}.
Updates calendar properties like name and color. Use list-calendars to find the calendar ID.
Cannot delete the default calendar (first in list-calendars). Returns 400 if attempted.
CRITICAL: Only works for meetings created via Graph API (not Teams UI). Updatable fields: subject, startDateTime, endDateTime, attendees.
CRITICAL: Only works for meetings created via Graph API.
Returns individual attendee records with attendanceIntervals (joinDateTime, leaveDateTime, durationInSeconds). Get report-id first from list-meeting-attendance-reports.
Updatable fields: displayName, description. membershipType cannot be changed after creation.
Cannot delete the General channel (default channel). Returns 400 if attempted.
Body: {'@odata.type': '#microsoft.graph.aadUserConversationMember', 'user@odata.bind': 'https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/users/{user-id}', roles: ['owner'] or []}. roles=[] for regular member.
conversationMember-id is from list-team-members (different from user-id). Get it first via list-team-members.
Returns Microsoft 365 Groups and Security Groups. Use $filter=groupTypes/any(c:c eq 'Unified') to get only M365 groups (Teams-linked). group-id = team-id for Teams.
Returns a single group by ID. group-id = team-id for Teams-linked groups.
Returns a single mail folder by ID. Well-known folder names can be used: inbox, drafts, sentitems, deleteditems, junkemail, archive.

Body: {displayName, sequence (int, lower=higher priority), isEnabled, conditions: {senderContains, subjectContains, ...}, actions: {moveToFolder, markAsRead, ...}}. Full schema: https://learn.microsoft.com/graph/api/resources/messagerule
Updates an existing inbox message rule. Use list-mail-rules to find rule IDs.
Deletes an inbox message rule. Use list-mail-rules to find rule IDs.
Returns all contact folders for the current user.
Body: {displayName (required), parentFolderId (optional, defaults to root contacts folder)}.
Returns the user's personal OneDrive. Use the returned id as drive-id for all /drives/{drive-id}/... operations. This is the primary way to discover your own drive-id.
Body: {fields: {ColumnName: value, ...}}. Column names are internal names (not display names) — use list-sharepoint-site-list to discover columns via $expand=columns.
Body: {fields: {ColumnName: value}}. Only include fields to update. CRITICAL: Requires If-Match header with ETag from list-sharepoint-site-list-items. Returns 412 without it.
Permanently deletes a SharePoint list item. Use list-sharepoint-site-list-items to find item IDs. Requires Sites.ReadWrite.All scope.
Returns a single Planner bucket by ID. Use list-planner-buckets to find bucket IDs. Response includes @odata.etag needed for update/delete operations.
CRITICAL: Requires If-Match header with ETag from get-planner-bucket. Body: {name} to rename bucket.
CRITICAL: Requires If-Match header with ETag from get-planner-bucket. Returns 412 without it.
Returns all tasks in a specific bucket. Use list-planner-buckets to get bucket IDs for a plan.

Body: {chatType: 'oneOnOne'/'group', members: [{'@odata.type': '#microsoft.graph.aadUserConversationMember', 'user@odata.bind': 'https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/users/{user-id}', roles: ['owner']}]}. For oneOnOne, include exactly 2 members (you + other).
Returns conversationMember objects with userId, displayName, roles. Use userId for further user lookups.
Returns members of a Microsoft 365 Group or Team. Each member includes id (user-id), displayName, mail. Use list-groups to find group-id.
Returns the SharePoint document library (drive) associated with a Microsoft 365 Group or Team. Use the returned id as drive-id for file operations on Teams/SharePoint files.
Returns recently accessed files from the user's OneDrive and SharePoint. Includes files opened from any device. Each item has id and parentReference.driveId for further operations.
Returns files and folders shared with the user. Each item has remoteItem.id and remoteItem.parentReference.driveId — use these (not the top-level id) for accessing the actual item.
Returns a single contact folder by ID. Use list-contact-folders to find folder IDs.
Body: {displayName} to rename folder.
Permanently deletes a contact folder and all contacts within it. Use list-contact-folders to find folder IDs.
Returns contacts in a specific folder. Use list-contact-folders to get folder IDs.
Returns plan details: categoryDescriptions (labels 1-6 used in task categories), sharedWith (who can access the plan). Use get-planner-plan for the plan title and other metadata.

Creates an upload session for files >4MB. Body: {item: {'@microsoft.graph.conflictBehavior': 'rename'/'replace', name: 'filename'}}. Returns uploadUrl (valid 48h) and expirationDateTime. Upload file in chunks via PUT to uploadUrl with Content-Range header. Final chunk returns driveItem.
Body: {toRecipients: [{emailAddress: {address, name}}], comment (optional)}. Forwards the meeting invitation to additional recipients. They receive the same meeting details as the original invite.
Returns report metadata: totalParticipantCount, meetingStartDateTime, meetingEndDateTime. Use list-attendance-report-participants for individual attendee records.

Body: {displayName (required), description (optional), members: [{'@odata.type': '#microsoft.graph.aadUserConversationMember', 'user@odata.bind': '...', roles: ['owner']}]}. Returns 202 Accepted — async. Check Location header for team provisioning status.
Returns installed apps in a team. Each app has teamsApp.id and teamsAppDefinition.displayName.
Returns members of a specific channel. For standard channels, returns all team members. For private/shared channels, returns only channel-specific members.

Required for private/shared channels — standard channels inherit team membership. Body: {'@odata.type': '#microsoft.graph.aadUserConversationMember', 'user@odata.bind': 'https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/users/{user-id}', roles: ['owner'] or []}.
conversationMember-id is from list-channel-members. Cannot remove members from standard channels (inherits from team).
Returns user profile: displayName, mail, jobTitle, department, officeLocation. Use list-users to find user IDs, or pass UPN (email address) as user-id directly.
Returns attachments on a calendar event. Each attachment has name, contentType, size. Use $expand=microsoft.graph.fileAttachment/contentBytes to get base64 content.

Body: {'@odata.type': '#microsoft.graph.fileAttachment', name (required), contentBytes (required, base64), contentType}. Max 3MB per attachment. For larger files, attach via OneDrive link using #microsoft.graph.itemAttachment.

Writes data to Excel cells. Body: {values: [['row1col1', 'row1col2'], ['row2col1', 'row2col2']]} for data, or {formulas: [['=SUM(A1:A5)']]} for formulas. address format: 'A1', 'A1:C3', 'Sheet1!A1:B2'. Use get-excel-range first to verify address.

Body: {displayName (required), color: 'preset0'-'preset24' or 'none'}. Color presets: preset0=red, preset1=orange, preset2=brown, preset3=yellow, preset4=green, preset5=teal, preset6=olive, preset7=blue, preset8=purple, preset9=cranberry.
Only color can be updated (displayName is immutable after creation). Body: {color: 'preset0'-'preset24' or 'none'}.
Permanently deletes a custom Outlook color category. Use list-outlook-categories to get the category ID. Built-in preset categories cannot be deleted.

Updatable fields: displayName, description, memberSettings, messagingSettings, funSettings, guestSettings, discoverySettings. Body example: {displayName: 'New Name', description: 'Updated description'}.
Returns all Planner plans in a Microsoft 365 Group (Team). group-id is the same as team-id from list-joined-teams. Alternative to list-planner-plans when you know the team but not the plan.
Returns column definitions with name (internal name), displayName, type. CRITICAL: Use the name field (not displayName) as the key in create/update-sharepoint-site-list-item body fields object.

Body: {displayName (required), columns: [{name, text: {}} or {name, number: {}} or {name, dateTime: {}}], list: {template: 'genericList'}}. template options: genericList, documentLibrary, survey, links, announcements, contacts.
Returns calendar events for a Microsoft 365 Group (shared team calendar). group-id is the same as team-id. Supports $filter, $orderby, $top. For recurring events use $expand=instances.
Returns tables in a worksheet with name, showHeaders, style. Use table name or id for list-excel-table-rows.
Returns all rows in an Excel table. Each row has index and values (array). Use $top and $skip for pagination on large tables.
Returns version history for a file. Each version has id, lastModifiedDateTime, size. Use version id to restore: PATCH /drives/{id}/items/{id}/versions/{versionId}/restoreVersion.
Returns sharing permissions. Each permission has roles (read/write/owner), grantedTo (user/group), link (sharing link). Use to audit who has access to a file.
Returns tags (subgroups) in a team. Tags can be @mentioned in channel messages to notify a subset of team members. Each tag has id, displayName, memberCount.
Body: {displayName (required), members: [{userId}]}. Creates a tag for @mentioning a subgroup. Max 25 tags per team, max 100 members per tag.
Returns pinned tabs in a channel. Each tab has displayName, webUrl, configuration (entityId, contentUrl). Common tabs: Word, Excel, PDF files, SharePoint pages, websites.
Returns SharePoint modern pages. Each page has name, title, webUrl, lastModifiedDateTime. Use $filter=pageLayoutType eq 'Article' for news articles only.
Archives a team — makes it read-only. Body: {shouldSetSpoSiteReadOnlyForMembers: true/false}. Archived teams still appear in Teams but cannot be posted to. Use unarchive-team to reactivate.
Restores an archived team to active status. After unarchiving, members can post messages and edit the team again. Use archive-team to archive.
Body: {name (optional, auto-generated if omitted)}. Returns new worksheet with id and name. Use update-excel-range to populate data.
Cannot delete the last remaining worksheet in a workbook. Returns 400 if only one sheet exists.

Body: {recipients: [{emailAddress: {address}}], roles: ['read'/'write'], sendInvitation: true/false, message: 'optional', requireSignIn: true/false}. roles: 'read' for view only, 'write' for edit. Use list-drive-item-permissions to see existing shares.
permission-id from list-drive-item-permissions. Cannot delete inherited permissions — only direct permissions. Sharing links have link-type permissions that can be removed.
Returns changed items since last sync. First call returns all items + deltaLink. Pass deltaLink token as $deltaToken on next call to get only changes. Use $select to limit fields returned per item.
Restores a previous version as current. version-id from list-drive-item-versions. Returns 204 No Content on success. Creates a new version entry rather than reverting version history.

Body: {destinationId: 'folder-id or well-known name'}. Well-known names: 'inbox', 'drafts', 'sentitems', 'deleteditems'. Returns 201 with the new message copy. Complement to move-mail-message which moves without copying.

Returns mail folders for another user's mailbox (shared mailbox or delegate access). user-id can be UPN (email) or Azure AD user ID. Requires explicit delegation — not just Mail.Read. Use list-mail-folders for your own folders.
Returns single attachment with contentBytes (base64) for file attachments. attachment-id from list-event-attachments.
Permanently removes an attachment from a calendar event. Use list-event-attachments to get the attachment-id. Cannot be undone.
Body: {newReminderTime: {dateTime: 'ISO 8601', timeZone: 'UTC'}}. Snoozes reminder until newReminderTime. Use get-calendar-event to find current reminderMinutesBeforeStart.
Dismisses the reminder for this event occurrence. No body required. Only affects the reminder — event remains on calendar.
Returns worksheet metadata: id, name, position, visibility. Use list-excel-worksheets to find worksheet IDs.
Body: {address (required, range like 'A1:D10'), hasHeaders: true/false}. Creates a table from an existing range. Use list-excel-tables to verify.
Body: {name, showHeaders, showTotals, style}. style options: 'TableStyleLight1'-'TableStyleLight21', 'TableStyleMedium1'-'TableStyleMedium28', 'TableStyleDark1'-'TableStyleDark11'.
Deletes the table structure but preserves the cell data. table-id from list-excel-tables.

Body: {persistChanges: true/false}. Returns workbook-session-id. Include workbook-session-id in Workbook-Session-Id request header for all subsequent Excel calls for better performance on large workbooks. Sessions expire after inactivity.
Closes the workbook session. Include same Workbook-Session-Id header. Always close sessions explicitly to free server resources. No body required.
Body: {displayName}. Only displayName can be updated. tag-id from list-team-tags.
Permanently deletes a tag from a team. All member associations are removed. Use list-team-tags to get the teamworkTag-id. Cannot be undone.
Returns members of a tag with id and displayName. Use member id (not userId) for remove-team-tag-member.
Body: {userId (required)}. userId is the Azure AD user ID from list-team-members or get-user. Max 100 members per tag.
teamworkTagMember-id from list-team-tag-members (id field, different from userId).

Body: {'teamsApp@odata.bind': 'https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/appCatalogs/teamsApps/{app-id}'}. app-id is the Teams app catalog ID — find it in AppSource or via Graph appCatalogs endpoint. Returns 201 on success.
teamsAppInstallation-id from list-team-apps (id field, NOT teamsApp.id). Returns 204 on success.
Returns tabs pinned in a chat with displayName, webUrl, configuration. chat-id from list-chats. For channel tabs use list-channel-tabs with team-id + channel-id.

Returns recording metadata: createdDateTime, recordingContentUrl. CRITICAL: Use recordingContentUrl to download — it expires after a short period. For transcripts use list-meeting-transcripts instead.
Returns recording metadata (createdDateTime, contentUrl). Use list-meeting-recordings to get the callRecording-id. Content download requires separate GET to contentUrl.
Returns content types for a SharePoint site. Each has id, name, description, group. Use $filter=group eq 'Custom Content Types' for custom types only.
Returns a single content type definition by ID. Use list-site-content-types to get available contentType-id values. Content types define the schema for SharePoint list items.

For mail attachments > 3MB. Body: {AttachmentItem: {attachmentType: 'file', name: 'filename.ext', size: [byte size as integer]}}. Returns uploadUrl and expirationDateTime. Upload in chunks via PUT to uploadUrl with Content-Range header (e.g. 'bytes 0-25214/26000'). Max chunk size: 60MB. Session expires in 2 days.

Returns current presence: availability (Available/Busy/Away/BeRightBack/DoNotDisturb/Offline/PresenceUnknown), activity (Available/InACall/InAMeeting/Presenting/etc). Use get-user-presence for other users.
Returns presence for any user. user-id can be UPN (email) or Azure AD user ID. availability and activity fields same as get-my-presence.

Body: {sessionId (required, any unique string per app instance), availability (required: Available/Busy/DoNotDisturb/BeRightBack/Away), activity (required: matches availability), expirationDuration (ISO 8601, e.g. PT1H)}. Use consistent sessionId per app instance — multiple sessions override each other.

Body: {changeType: 'created,updated,deleted', notificationUrl (public HTTPS), resource: '/me/messages', expirationDateTime, clientState (optional secret)}. notificationUrl must respond to Graph validation request (echo validationToken). Max expiry: mail/calendar/contacts 4230min, driveRoot 4230min.
Returns all active subscriptions. Use subscription id for renew-subscription or delete-subscription.
Body: {expirationDateTime (new expiry — must not exceed resource max)}. Renew before expiry to keep receiving change notifications. Returns 200 with updated subscription.
Permanently removes a change notification subscription. Notifications stop immediately. No request body needed.

Body: {displayName (required), mailNickname (required, no spaces), mailEnabled (required), securityEnabled (required), groupTypes: ['Unified'] for M365/Teams group or [] for security group}. M365: mailEnabled=true, securityEnabled=false, groupTypes=['Unified']. Security: mailEnabled=false, securityEnabled=true, groupTypes=[].
Updatable fields: displayName, description, visibility (Private/Public/HiddenMembership). mailNickname cannot be changed. Returns 204 No Content.
Soft-deletes — recoverable for 30 days via Azure AD deleted items restore. M365 groups only. Security groups require different permission flow.

CRITICAL: Requires If-Match header with ETag from get-planner-plan-details. Body: {categoryDescriptions: {category1: 'LabelName', category2: 'LabelName', ...category6: 'LabelName'}} to set task label names. sharedWith: {'{userId}': true} to add plan member, {'{userId}': false} to remove.

Returns raw RFC 2822 MIME content of an email. Useful for archiving or parsing full email headers/body outside Graph. Response is raw MIME string (not JSON). message-id from list-mail-messages or get-mail-message.

Returns files trending around the user based on network activity. Each item has resource (driveItem with id/name/webUrl), resourceVisualization (title, previewImageUrl), lastModifiedDateTime. Use to surface relevant files without searching.

Returns files recently viewed or modified by the user. Sorted by lastUsed.lastAccessedDateTime desc. Each item has resource (driveItem) and resourceVisualization. Use to find recently worked-on files.

Returns files shared with or by the user. Each item has resourceVisualization, sharingHistory (who shared, when). Filter with $filter=sharing/sharedBy/user/id eq '{user-id}' to filter by specific sharer.

Returns sharing permissions for a calendar. Each permission has emailAddress, role (read/write/freeBusyRead/custom/owner/delegate), isRemovable, isInsideOrganization. Use to audit who has access to a calendar.
Body: {role: 'read'/'write'/'freeBusyRead'/'custom'/'owner'/'delegate'}. calendarPermission-id from list-calendar-permissions.
Removes sharing access. Only removable permissions (isRemovable=true) can be deleted — owner permission cannot be removed.
Returns profile photo as binary JPEG. Returns 404 if no photo set. Use GET /me/photo (without $value) to get metadata (width, height, id) first.
Body: binary JPEG image data. Content-Type must be image/jpeg. Max 4MB. Minimum 48x48px. Returns 200 on success. Only JPEG format is supported.

Returns all meeting rooms in the organization. Each room has displayName, emailAddress, capacity, building, floorNumber, isWheelChairAccessible. Use emailAddress as attendee address when booking a room via create-calendar-event.
Returns room lists (building/floor groupings). Each roomList has displayName, emailAddress. Use with $filter=displayName eq 'Building A' to find rooms in a specific building.

Body: {emailAddresses: ['recipient@example.com'], mailTipsOptions: 'automaticReplies,mailboxFullStatus,outOfOffice,deliveryRestriction,maxMessageSize'}. Returns OOF status and auto-reply message per recipient. Use before send-mail to check if recipients are out of office.

Body: {schedules: ['user@example.com', 'room@example.com'], startTime: {dateTime: 'ISO 8601', timeZone: 'UTC'}, endTime: {dateTime: 'ISO 8601', timeZone: 'UTC'}, availabilityViewInterval: 30}. Returns free/busy blocks per schedule. scheduleItems show busy slots with subject if permission allows. Use for meeting scheduling and room availability checks.
Returns the user's direct manager as a directoryObject. Use $select=displayName,mail,jobTitle to get user fields. Returns 404 if user has no manager. user-id can be UPN (email) or Azure AD ID.
Returns direct reports of the user. Each item is a directoryObject — use $select=displayName,mail,jobTitle to get user fields. Returns empty array if user has no direct reports.

Body: {values: [['col1', 'col2', ...]]} to append a row, or {index: 0, values: [...]} to insert at specific position (0-based). Omit index to append at end. Column count must match the table's column count exactly.
Returns owners of the group as directoryObjects. Use $select=displayName,mail,jobTitle to get user fields. Owners can manage the group (add/remove members, update settings).
Body: {'@odata.id': 'https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/users/{user-id}'}. Adds a user as group owner. Returns 204 on success. Max 100 owners per group.
user-id from list-group-owners. Cannot remove the last owner — group must have at least 1 owner at all times. Returns 204 on success.

Returns available thumbnail sizes: small (48px), medium (176px), large (800px), source (original). Each size has url (expires ~1h), width, height. Use $select=large to get only the large thumbnail. url can be used directly in img tags.
Returns activity history for a file. Each activity has action (create/edit/delete/move/rename/share/restore/version), actor (user displayName + id), activityDateTime. Use $top to limit results.

Body: {invitedUserEmailAddress (required), inviteRedirectUrl (required), invitedUserDisplayName (optional), sendInvitationMessage: true/false, invitedUserMessageInfo: {messageBody: 'Custom message'}}. Returns invitedUser with id. Guest account is created in Azure AD — use id for further Graph operations.

Returns soft-deleted M365 groups within 30-day retention window. Each item has id, displayName, deletedDateTime. Change path suffix to microsoft.graph.user for deleted users (requires User.ReadWrite.All). Use restore-deleted-item to recover.
Restores a soft-deleted M365 group or user. directory-object-id from list-deleted-items. Returns the restored object. Cannot restore after 30-day retention window.

Returns named ranges and formulas in the workbook. Each item has name, type (Range/Formula), value (range address like 'Sheet1!A1:B10' or formula result). Use name as address in get-excel-range/update-excel-range.
Returns a specific named range or formula by name (case-sensitive). type: 'Range' returns range address; 'Formula' returns calculated value.
